No new row this run: 688425.SS is the SIXTH consecutive dive to decline TOO_LATE, and this one declines for a structurally different reason than the five before it, which is worth separating from the escalation rather than folding into it. The first five declined because estimate revisions moved WITH the multiple, a judgement about two moving numbers. This one declines because the multiple moved the WRONG WAY: over twelve months the share fell 29.17% while the trailing earnings base fell only 1.65%, so the trailing P/E went 20.37x to 14.67x, -27.98%, and the price now sits 0.97% BELOW its last pre-announcement close of 2025-07-18 and 47.15% below the 2025-07-24 event peak. Method section 7 makes TOO_LATE conditional on the decomposition SHOWING that multiple expansion ate the runway, and here there is no expansion left to decompose. THE FINDING THAT FALLS OUT OF SIX: TOO_LATE as the method defines it can only be written over a name whose multiple has EXPANDED, and this funnel keeps delivering names whose multiples have CONTRACTED. That is a property of the vocabulary meeting the pipeline, not necessarily of an analyst who cannot say no, and it is a cheaper explanation of a 0-for-6 record than either of the two Ron was offered last run. Escalated as an amendment to the escalation, not resolved here. The single open row SHD-20260829-01 still grades on 2026-11-27.

red_team_amendments.question: How often does my own attack change my draft, and which attack lands?
red_team_amendments.note: An attack dimension that has never amended anything is either unnecessary or being performed rather than run, and naming which is part of the report. After run 3 (HUBB): CROWDEDNESS_REALITY landed a second time, arguing 99.03% institutional ownership contradicts an UNDISCOVERED label the draft had reframed as settled rather than contested. PRICED_IN_CHECK and CAPTURE_REALITY landed a third straight time, both finding the same shape of problem: a headline number (a claimed gap, a demand narrative) survives only because a category mismatch or an unquantified attribution was not stress-tested. EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY landed a second time, and not on a data gap this time but on a structural defect: HUBB's independence_test.falsification described the conditions that would CONFIRM the dive, the exact polarity error the repairs log first caught on VRT on 2026-08-29, now caught and fixed a second time on a different file, which argues this specific defect class needs a machine check rather than continued reliance on this attack finding it by hand. PRE_MORTEM stays at 1 of 3 rather than inflated: on HUBB, same as MYRG, the market-would-have-been-right question was answerable (continued margin expansion on Hubbell's own established trend) and the verdict was already at WATCH, the floor that gate imposes, so the pre-mortem informed the file without changing the label. Three of three dives amended is now a pattern worth naming plainly: this red team has never once confirmed a draft unchanged, which either means the draft stage is consistently leaving real gaps for the fresh-context pass to find, or the red team is calibrated to always find something. The failure modes have not repeated across dives (VRT: horizon convention; MYRG: base-year outlier and an invented trigger price; HUBB: category-mismatched gap survival, an unverified AI-attribution, an invented trigger threshold, and a falsifier with inverted polarity), which argues for the former reading, but three data points is not enough to rule out the latter. After run 4 (ANDR.VI): four of four dives amended, and the open question from run 3 is now answerable in one direction at least. The failure modes have still not repeated across dives, which is the evidence for 'the draft stage keeps leaving real gaps' over 'the red team is calibrated to always find something': VRT was a horizon convention, MYRG a base-year outlier and an invented trigger price, HUBB a category-mismatched gap and an inverted falsifier, and ANDR.VI a THIRD distinct convention defect (an undeclared cash-conversion assumption) plus a fact the draft never looked up (the Q1/Q2 split of the surge its whole thesis rests on). CAPTURE_REALITY landed a fourth straight time and landed hardest here: the dive's occurrence-to-issuer link turned out to be thematic rather than contractual, with no Chinese content in any named order. EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY is counted for the run's VENDOR_DATA_REALITY attack, which is the same dimension under the name this invocation used; it found that the two clean earnings-quality inputs are clean BECAUSE of the missing one, since customer advances mechanically push accruals negative. PRE_MORTEM stays honestly at 1 of 4 rather than inflated: the market-would-have-been-right story (a mix shift inside Hydropower toward higher-margin modernisation work the file could not see) was answerable and the verdict was already at WATCH, the floor that gate can impose.

implied_growth.question: The market-implied CAGR I recorded at dive time, against what was actually delivered by review_by.
implied_growth.note: This grades the reverse DCF itself. Without it the gap table is a format, not a method. Run 1 found the implied column is one point on a horizon curve. Run 2 found the deeper problem: the column also inherits a BASE, and on MYRG that base is FY2025 free cash flow at 2.90x the trailing four-year average. A horizon sensitivity is published on disk; a base sensitivity is not. When these records resolve, grade the solve against the base as well as the horizon, or this channel will keep grading the less important of the two inputs. Run 4 (ANDR.VI) adds the third distinct defect class in this column: after the horizon (VRT) and the base (MYRG), the DISCOUNT RATE. quality.reverse_dcf assumes 9% for a EUR-denominated net-cash Austrian industrial and publishes no sensitivity to it, and the direction matters: a lower rate lowers the implied CAGR and would widen the dive's gap in its own favour. The dive stated the direction and did not touch the number, because section 7 forbids re-solving in session. When these records resolve, the solve should be graded against its discount rate as well as its base and its horizon, or this channel keeps grading the least consequential of the three inputs. Run 4's red team adds a FOURTH defect class to this column, and it is the first one that lives in the DIVE's own bridge rather than in the filed solve: after the horizon (VRT), the base (MYRG) and the discount rate (ANDR.VI at draft), the CASH CONVERSION assumption that turns an EBITA CAGR into an FCF-CAGR-equivalent. It is undeclared, it is the most volatile ratio in the file, and reverting it to the four-year mean flips the sign of the gap. Three of the four defect classes are conventions that were never written down, which argues the standing lesson of this channel is not about the reverse DCF at all: it is that any comparison between a dive's expectation and a filed solve must enumerate every convention on both sides before it claims a gap.

open_records.my_fcf_cagr_note: Written as a number this time, unlike the MYRG and HUBB records, because this dive actually built one rather than comparing a revenue rate to an FCF rate: revenue 9,815.7 MEUR in 2030 at a comparable EBITA margin held flat at 8.6% gives EBITA of 844.2 MEUR against 646.4 MEUR in 2025, a 5.49% CAGR, at unchanged cash conversion. Against the filed 5-year implied 5.3% that is a gap of +0.19pp, inside the file's own 1.21pp horizon_spread, which is why the dive claims NO measurable gap. At the 10-year convention (4.09% implied) the same expectation is +1.40pp ahead, wider than the spread, so the SIGN of the finding depends on the convention; the dive claims the filed 5-year default and says so. AMENDED by the red team 2026-09-02: the arithmetic was re-derived independently and is exactly right, but the three words 'at unchanged cash conversion' are a SECOND undeclared convention doing as much work as the horizon. Free cash flow over operating income runs 1.030 / 0.306 / 0.704 / 0.776 across FY2022-2025. Hold every other input and move only that point from FY2025 to the four-year mean, and this 5.49% becomes 3.45%, a gap of MINUS 1.85pp against the filed 5.3%, wider than the 1.21pp horizon spread and opposite in sign to the 10-year reading. When this record resolves, grade the solve against the conversion assumption as well as the base, the horizon and the discount rate, or the channel will keep grading the smallest of four inputs.

Method section 7 defines TOO_LATE as requiring the priced-in decomposition to SHOW that multiple expansion ate the runway. dives.one_line: The market bought the CNY 1.2 trillion headline and has already given all of it back: 4.12 the day before the groundbreaking, 7.72 four sessions later, 4.08 now, which is 0.97% BELOW where it started, and the twelve-month move is 100% multiple contraction rather than the expansion TOO_LATE needs. The sizing error is visible: the TBM slice of the scheme is put at 25 machines of CNY 200-300m, roughly 5.0-7.5bn across at least two suppliers and a decade, against a company already earning 10bn a year. Earnings grade C caps the verdict independently, on contract liabilities halving and DSO at 314 days. The one thing that would prove this wrong is contract liabilities back above 1.0bn, a level held twelve months ago.
